references.text: Moses was commanded to gather the consecration offering, including the basket of unleavened bread, as part of the priestly ordination.
The basket of unleavened bread was used during the ordination of Aaron and his sons, as described in this parallel text.
A basket of unleavened bread was also used in the Nazirite vow, showing similar sacrificial practices.
The context for this verse, where the ingredients of the basket and the sacrifices (the bull and the two rams) are described.
Regulations concerning unleavened bread baked in an oven as part of a grain offering, similar to the loaves in the basket.
Direct continuity: The next step in the same ordination ritual (the second ram).
Direct continuity: The earlier step in the same ordination ritual (the first ram).
Direct continuity: Detailed preparation of the ram mentioned in the source text.
